items.lede: Erratic Muse outputs sharing random bank, bitcoin balances aren’t real, Meta says.
items.title: Muse privacy invasions are freaking out Meta staffers, internal chats show

items.lede: In some of these instances, employees said Muse surfaced messages about childcare requests they never made, career advice they never asked for, product orders they never placed, and bank account balances that didn't belong to them.
items.title: Meta’s AI agent Muse is mixing up conversations and exposing private data, report says

items.lede: Meta employees have reported alarming privacy violations involving Muse, including unauthorized actions. An investigation also found the AI agent accessed private messages.
items.title: Meta Muse booked an Airbnb without permission – and that’s not the worst of it
